sloka: दत्तं न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मो ऽपि तप एव निषेवसे ।तेन स्वर्गगतो वत्स बाध्यसे क्षुत्पिपासया ।। ७.७८.१७ ॥
transliteration: dattaṁ na te 'sti sūkṣmo 'pi tapa eva niṣevase ।tena svargagato vatsa bādhyase kṣutpipāsayā ।। 7.78.17 ॥

translations.english: You have not given even a little charity, having only practiced penance; therefore, O child, even after reaching heaven, you are tormented by hunger and thirst.
